entities.summary: António Cordeiro was a Portuguese Catholic priest in the Society of Jesus and historian. He was the author of the classical chronicle História Insulana, and first to publish a public opinion on the form of governance for the archipelago of the Azores.

entities.summary: António Cordeiro was a Portuguese Catholic priest in the Society of Jesus and historian. He was the author of the classical chronicle História Insulana, and first to publish a public opinion on the form of governance for the archipelago of the Azores.
